ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ) has secured a 30-year Build, Operate, Transfer (BOT) concession for two dry bulk berths at Paradip Port, adding 18 MMT to its mechanized capacity. This strategic expansion significantly boosts APSEZ's domestic portfolio to 671 MMT, advancing its goal of 1 billion tonnes cargo throughput by 2030 and strengthening its presence on India's East Coast. While the exact financial consideration depends on future cargo volumes, no immediate red flags are noted, highlighting a positive growth trajectory.
